text: AI decompositions of high-value ideas land as ai-proposition for human acceptance
description: Human-in-the-loop rule for the harness decomposition stage: children proposed under ideas above a value threshold (strategy level) are created in state ai-proposition, so the loop does not act on them until Felix accepts (-> open) or rejects (-> cancelled, with reason, which then feeds the cancelled-lookalike context). Below the threshold, children are created open and the loop proceeds. Threshold in harness config. Needs a fast accept/reject view (filter by state ai-proposition already works in search).

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Bounding the ai-proposition queue by size and age keeps each proposition fresh enough to get a real judgment instead of a reflexive accept; refuted if the throttle never fires over two weeks of harness runs.
